name: c1_01-options-dialog
note: U-10: legacy C1_01, no movement. F12 at 300 and Alt+P at 500 each open the options dialog 0x45cff0 (command_key 0x4607d7; dialog 0x4566e0, run 0x456d68); each is answered by a pump-keyed Esc in the same frame (cancel button 10 -> action 10: prefs read-modify-write 0x4574e8, exit). For Alt+P the Alt key-up is pump-keyed before the Esc (Alt+Esc would be the focus key 201h). Bounded window of 700 frames.
